build_ContrastiveEmbed: build a ContrastiveEmbed layer for text-visual contrastive classification with configurable max text length and log scale
build_GroundingDINOHead: build a GroundingDINOHead detection head for open-set object detection with text grounding support
review_GroundingDINOHead_forward: review the GroundingDINOHead forward method that computes classification and regression outputs across decoder layers
review_GroundingDINOHead_loss: review the GroundingDINOHead loss method that computes classification, bbox, and IoU losses for training
review_GroundingDINOHead_predict: review the GroundingDINOHead predict method that performs forward propagation and returns detection results
